description: Dependency updates for Insaniquarium - Remastered Mod: GitHub Actions, the CI image, the co-op server images and the versions pinned in tools/fetch-deps.sh. Setup: DEVELOPING.md

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one pull request for all of them
The CI image (node:24-bookworm) fixes the compiler, so releases stay reproducible: changing it is a deliberate change, by hand
A new Postgres major version needs a data migration (dump and restore): never propose it automatically
Nothing merges itself: every update is built and tried in the game first

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in shell scripts with a '# renovate:' comment (tools/fetch-deps.sh)
